panels.title: Server

panels.description: Network I/O: bytes sent and received per connection

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 10
  c.client_net_address AS [Client],
  CAST(SUM(c.num_reads)*8.0/1024 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS [Recv MB],
  CAST(SUM(c.num_writes)*8.0/1024 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS [Sent MB],
  COUNT(*) AS [Conn]
FROM sys.dm_exec_connections c
GROUP BY c.client_net_address
ORDER BY SUM(c.num_reads+c.num_writes) DESC;
-- Grafana refresh dependencies: ${ag_listener:raw} | ${ag_cluster:raw} | ${replica_ds:raw} | ${replica_name:raw}

panels.title: Edition
🛡 AVAILABILITY GROUP HEALTH  (via AG Listener → primary view)
👑 Current Primary
panels.description: Primary replica of the selected AG as reported through the listener

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ags.primary_replica AS [Primary]
FROM sys.availability_groups ag
JOIN sys.dm_hadr_availability_group_states ags ON ag.group_id = ags.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster';

panels.title: 🎭 Selected Replica Role
panels.description: Role of the replica chosen in the Replica control

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 1 rs.role_desc AS [Role]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_availability_replica_states rs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON rs.replica_id = ar.replica_id AND rs.group_id = ar.group_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON rs.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster'
AND ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name';

panels.title: 💓 Selected Replica Health
panels.description: Synchronization health of the chosen replica

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 1 rs.synchronization_health_desc AS [Health]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_availability_replica_states rs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON rs.replica_id = ar.replica_id AND rs.group_id = ar.group_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON rs.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster'
AND ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name';

panels.title: ⚠️ Not Synced DBs
panels.description: Databases not SYNCHRONIZED / SYNCHRONIZING (scope-filtered)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS [DBs]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON drs.replica_id = ar.replica_id AND drs.group_id = ar.group_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON drs.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster' AND ('$scope' = 'All' OR ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name')
AND drs.synchronization_state_desc NOT IN ('SYNCHRONIZED','SYNCHRONIZING');

panels.title: ⏸ Suspended DBs
panels.description: Databases with data movement suspended

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS [DBs]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON drs.replica_id = ar.replica_id AND drs.group_id = ar.group_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON drs.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster' AND ('$scope' = 'All' OR ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name')
AND drs.is_suspended = 1;

panels.title: 📉 Est. Data Loss (RPO)
panels.description: log_send_queue / log_send_rate - seconds of data not yet sent to the replica

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN drs.log_send_queue_size = 0 THEN 0 WHEN drs.log_send_rate > 0 THEN drs.log_send_queue_size * 1.0 / drs.log_send_rate END), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS [RPO s]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON drs.replica_id = ar.replica_id AND drs.group_id = ar.group_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON drs.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster' AND ('$scope' = 'All' OR ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name');

panels.title: ⏱ Est. Recovery (RTO)
panels.description: redo_queue / redo_rate - seconds for the secondary to finish redo before it can take over

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN drs.redo_queue_size = 0 THEN 0 WHEN drs.redo_rate > 0 THEN drs.redo_queue_size * 1.0 / drs.redo_rate END), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS [RTO s]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON drs.replica_id = ar.replica_id AND drs.group_id = ar.group_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON drs.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster' AND ('$scope' = 'All' OR ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name');

panels.title: 🗳 Cluster Quorum
panels.description: WSFC quorum state

targets.rawSql: SELECT quorum_state_desc AS [Quorum] FROM sys.dm_hadr_cluster;

panels.title: 🚫 Not Failover Ready
panels.description: Synchronous-commit DB copies that are NOT failover-ready (scope-filtered)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS [DBs]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_cluster_states cs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON cs.replica_id = ar.replica_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON ar.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster' AND ('$scope' = 'All' OR ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name') AND ar.availability_mode_desc = 'SYNCHRONOUS_COMMIT' AND cs.is_failover_ready = 0;

panels.title: 🔁 Sync-Commit Wait (avg)
panels.description: Average HADR_SYNC_COMMIT wait per commit since instance start - the latency cost of synchronous replicas

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(ISNULL(wait_time_ms * 1.0 / NULLIF(waiting_tasks_count, 0), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [ms]
FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type = 'HADR_SYNC_COMMIT';

panels.title: 🕒 Max Secondary Lag
panels.description: Highest secondary_lag_seconds (SQL Server 2016+)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(drs.secondary_lag_seconds), 0) AS [Lag s]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON drs.replica_id = ar.replica_id AND drs.group_id = ar.group_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON drs.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster' AND ('$scope' = 'All' OR ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name');

panels.title: 🩹 Auto Page Repairs
panels.description: Rows in sys.dm_hadr_auto_page_repair (corruption healed from a replica)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS [Repairs] FROM sys.dm_hadr_auto_page_repair;

panels.title: ☠️ Suspect Pages
panels.description: Rows in msdb.dbo.suspect_pages (possible corruption)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS [Pages] FROM msdb.dbo.suspect_pages;

panels.title: 🛡 AG Overview
panels.description: AG status as seen through the listener

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ag.name AS [AG], ags.primary_replica AS [Primary],
       ags.synchronization_health_desc AS [Sync Health],
       ags.primary_recovery_health_desc AS [Primary Recovery],
       ags.secondary_recovery_health_desc AS [Secondary Recovery],
       ag.automated_backup_preference_desc AS [Backup Pref],
       ag.failure_condition_level AS [Failure Level], ag.health_check_timeout AS [Health Timeout ms]
FROM sys.availability_groups ag
JOIN sys.dm_hadr_availability_group_states ags ON ag.group_id = ags.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster';

panels.title: 📡 AG Listener & Cluster Nodes
panels.description: Listener IPs and WSFC member states

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'LISTENER' AS [Kind], l.dns_name AS [Name], CAST(l.port AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS [Port / Votes],
       ISNULL(ip.ip_address, '') AS [IP], ISNULL(ip.state_desc, '') AS [State]
FROM sys.availability_group_listeners l
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON l.group_id = ag.group_id
LEFT JOIN sys.availability_group_listener_ip_addresses ip ON l.listener_id = ip.listener_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'NODE', member_name, CAST(number_of_quorum_votes AS NVARCHAR(10)), member_type_desc, member_state_desc
FROM sys.dm_hadr_cluster_members;

panels.title: 🖥 Replica States
panels.description: Role, connectivity, health, commit/failover mode of each replica (scope-filtered)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ar.replica_server_name AS [Replica], rs.role_desc AS [Role],
       rs.connected_state_desc AS [Connected], rs.operational_state_desc AS [Operational],
       rs.synchronization_health_desc AS [Sync Health],
       ar.availability_mode_desc AS [Availability Mode], ar.failover_mode_desc AS [Failover Mode],
       ar.seeding_mode_desc AS [Seeding], ar.secondary_role_allow_connections_desc AS [Readable Secondary],
       ar.session_timeout AS [Session Timeout s], ar.backup_priority AS [Backup Priority],
       rs.last_connect_error_description AS [Last Connect Error]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_availability_replica_states rs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON rs.replica_id = ar.replica_id AND rs.group_id = ar.group_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON rs.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster' AND ('$scope' = 'All' OR ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name')
ORDER BY ar.replica_server_name;

panels.title: 🧯 Failover Readiness (RPO / RTO per database)
panels.description: Per DB copy: failover-ready flag, estimated data loss (send queue ÷ send rate) and estimated recovery time (redo queue ÷ redo rate)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cs.database_name AS [Database], ar.replica_server_name AS [Replica],
       ar.availability_mode_desc AS [Mode], ar.failover_mode_desc AS [Failover],
       CASE WHEN cs.is_failover_ready = 1 THEN 'READY' ELSE 'NOT READY' END AS [Failover Ready],
       drs.synchronization_state_desc AS [Sync State],
       CAST(CASE WHEN drs.log_send_queue_size = 0 THEN 0 WHEN drs.log_send_rate > 0 THEN drs.log_send_queue_size * 1.0 / drs.log_send_rate END AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS [Est Data Loss s],
       CAST(CASE WHEN drs.redo_queue_size = 0 THEN 0 WHEN drs.redo_rate > 0 THEN drs.redo_queue_size * 1.0 / drs.redo_rate END AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS [Est Recovery s],
       cs.is_pending_secondary_suspend AS [Pending Suspend]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_cluster_states cs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON cs.replica_id = ar.replica_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON ar.group_id = ag.group_id
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs ON drs.replica_id = cs.replica_id AND drs.group_database_id = cs.group_database_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster' AND ('$scope' = 'All' OR ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name')
ORDER BY cs.database_name, ar.replica_server_name;

panels.title: 🗃 Database Replica States
panels.description: Sync state, queues (KB), rates and last commit per DB / replica (scope-filtered)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DB_NAME(drs.database_id) AS [Database], ar.replica_server_name AS [Replica],
       drs.synchronization_state_desc AS [Sync State], drs.synchronization_health_desc AS [Sync Health],
       drs.is_suspended AS [Suspended], drs.suspend_reason_desc AS [Suspend Reason],
       drs.log_send_queue_size AS [Log Send Queue KB], drs.redo_queue_size AS [Redo Queue KB],
       drs.log_send_rate AS [Send KB/s], drs.redo_rate AS [Redo KB/s],
       drs.secondary_lag_seconds AS [Lag s], drs.last_commit_time AS [Last Commit]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON drs.replica_id = ar.replica_id AND drs.group_id = ar.group_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON drs.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster' AND ('$scope' = 'All' OR ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name')
ORDER BY DB_NAME(drs.database_id), ar.replica_server_name;

panels.title: 📤 Log Send Queue
panels.description: Unsent log waiting for the replica (KB)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 15 DB_NAME(drs.database_id) + ' → ' + ar.replica_server_name AS [DB → Replica], ISNULL(drs.log_send_queue_size, 0) AS [Log Send Queue KB]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON drs.replica_id = ar.replica_id AND drs.group_id = ar.group_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON drs.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster' AND ('$scope' = 'All' OR ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name')
ORDER BY drs.log_send_queue_size DESC;

panels.title: 📥 Redo Queue
panels.description: Received but not yet redone (KB)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 15 DB_NAME(drs.database_id) + ' → ' + ar.replica_server_name AS [DB → Replica], ISNULL(drs.redo_queue_size, 0) AS [Redo Queue KB]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON drs.replica_id = ar.replica_id AND drs.group_id = ar.group_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON drs.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster' AND ('$scope' = 'All' OR ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name')
ORDER BY drs.redo_queue_size DESC;

panels.title: 🕒 Secondary Lag
panels.description: secondary_lag_seconds

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 15 DB_NAME(drs.database_id) + ' → ' + ar.replica_server_name AS [DB → Replica], ISNULL(drs.secondary_lag_seconds, 0) AS [Lag s]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON drs.replica_id = ar.replica_id AND drs.group_id = ar.group_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON drs.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster' AND ('$scope' = 'All' OR ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name')
ORDER BY drs.secondary_lag_seconds DESC;

panels.title: 🌐 AG Transport (per replica, live)
panels.description: Bytes sent/received, flow-control time and resent messages per second between replicas (sampled 1 s). Rising Flow Ctrl ms/s = network or secondary cannot keep up.

panels.title: 🚀 Log Send / Redo Rate
panels.description: Current log send and redo rates (KB/s)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 20 DB_NAME(drs.database_id) + ' → ' + ar.replica_server_name AS [DB → Replica], ISNULL(drs.log_send_rate, 0) AS [Send KB/s], ISNULL(drs.redo_rate, 0) AS [Redo KB/s]
FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON drs.replica_id = ar.replica_id AND drs.group_id = ar.group_id
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON drs.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = '$ag_cluster' AND ('$scope' = 'All' OR ar.replica_server_name = '$replica_name')
ORDER BY drs.log_send_rate DESC;

panels.title: 📜 AG Events (AlwaysOn_health: failovers, state changes, lease expiry)
panels.description: Latest events from the AlwaysOn_health Extended Events session of the primary. Requires VIEW SERVER STATE.

defaults.noValue: No AG events found (or AlwaysOn_health files not readable)

panels.title: ⏳ HADR Wait Types
panels.description: Cumulative HADR_* waits since start (HADR_SYNC_COMMIT = sync-commit latency)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 10 wait_type AS [Wait Type], wait_time_ms AS [Wait ms]
FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats
WHERE wait_type LIKE 'HADR%' AND wait_time_ms > 0
  AND wait_type NOT IN ('HADR_FILESTREAM_IOMGR_IOCOMPLETION','HADR_WORK_QUEUE','HADR_CLUSAPI_CALL','HADR_TIMER_TASK','HADR_LOGCAPTURE_WAIT','HADR_NOTIFICATION_DEQUEUE','HADR_FABRIC_CALLBACK')
ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC;

panels.title: 🔥 SQL CPU % (last min)
panels.description: SQL Server process CPU, latest ring-buffer sample

panels.title: 🧵 Worker Threads Used
panels.description: current workers / max_workers_count. THREADPOOL waits start near 100 %

panels.title: 💽 Min Disk Free %
panels.description: Lowest free space across volumes that hold database files

panels.title: 📝 Max Log Used %
panels.description: Highest transaction-log usage across databases

panels.title: ⏳ Oldest Open Txn
panels.description: Age (minutes) of the oldest user transaction - long transactions block log truncation and cause blocking

panels.title: ❌ Failed Jobs (24 h)
panels.description: SQL Agent job failures in the last 24 hours

panels.title: 💾 Full Backup Late
panels.description: User DBs (preferred-replica only) with no full backup within $full_backup_hours h

panels.title: 📼 Log Backup Late
panels.description: FULL/BULK_LOGGED DBs (preferred replica) with no log backup within $log_backup_min min - log will grow

panels.title: 🧪 CHECKDB Overdue
panels.description: DBs without a clean DBCC CHECKDB within $checkdb_days days

panels.title: ⛔ Blocked Sessions
panels.description: Requests currently blocked

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS [Blocked] FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE blocking_session_id > 0;
-- Grafana refresh dependencies: ${ag_listener:raw} | ${ag_cluster:raw} | ${replica_ds:raw} | ${replica_name:raw}

panels.title: 💀 Deadlocks (24 h)
panels.description: xml_deadlock_report events in the system_health ring buffer (last 24 h)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS [Deadlocks]
FROM (SELECT CAST(t.target_data AS XML) AS x FROM sys.dm_xe_sessions s
      JOIN sys.dm_xe_session_targets t ON s.address = t.event_session_address
      WHERE s.name = 'system_health' AND t.target_name = 'ring_buffer') a
CROSS APPLY a.x.nodes('RingBufferTarget/event[@name="xml_deadlock_report"]') n(e)
WHERE n.e.value('(@timestamp)[1]', 'datetime2') > DATEADD(HOUR, -24, GETUTCDATE());
-- Grafana refresh dependencies: ${ag_listener:raw} | ${ag_cluster:raw} | ${replica_ds:raw} | ${replica_name:raw}

panels.title: 🪵 Log Can't Truncate
panels.description: DBs whose log_reuse_wait is not NOTHING / CHECKPOINT / LOG_BACKUP (e.g. AVAILABILITY_REPLICA, ACTIVE_TRANSACTION)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS [DBs] FROM sys.databases WHERE database_id > 4 AND log_reuse_wait_desc NOT IN ('NOTHING','CHECKPOINT','LOG_BACKUP');
-- Grafana refresh dependencies: ${ag_listener:raw} | ${ag_cluster:raw} | ${replica_ds:raw} | ${replica_name:raw}

panels.title: 🧮 CPU History (ring buffer, per minute)
panels.description: SQL Server vs other-process CPU from the scheduler-monitor ring buffer (~4 h of history, no collector needed)

panels.title: 💽 Disk Space by Volume
panels.description: Free space for every volume that holds database files

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.volume_mount_point AS [Volume], v.logical_volume_name AS [Label],
       CAST(v.total_bytes / 1073741824.0 AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS [Total GB],
       CAST(v.available_bytes / 1073741824.0 AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS [Free GB],
       CAST(100.0 * v.available_bytes / NULLIF(v.total_bytes, 0) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS [Free %]
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT vs.volume_mount_point, vs.logical_volume_name, vs.total_bytes, vs.available_bytes
      FROM sys.master_files mf CROSS APPLY sys.dm_os_volume_stats(mf.database_id, mf.file_id) vs) v
ORDER BY [Free %];
-- Grafana refresh dependencies: ${ag_listener:raw} | ${ag_cluster:raw} | ${replica_ds:raw} | ${replica_name:raw}

panels.title: 🧬 Database Risk Register
panels.description: One row per DB: state, log reuse wait, log usage, backup ages, CHECKDB age and risky settings

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.name AS [Database], d.state_desc AS [State], d.recovery_model_desc AS [Recovery],
       d.log_reuse_wait_desc AS [Log Reuse Wait],
       CAST(lu.v AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS [Log Used %],
       DATEDIFF(HOUR, b.full_dt, GETDATE()) AS [Full Age h],
       DATEDIFF(HOUR, b.diff_dt, GETDATE()) AS [Diff Age h],
       DATEDIFF(MINUTE, b.log_dt, GETDATE()) AS [Log Age min],
       DATEDIFF(DAY, CAST(DATABASEPROPERTYEX(d.name, 'LastGoodCheckDbTime') AS DATETIME), GETDATE()) AS [CheckDB Age d],
       d.page_verify_option_desc AS [Page Verify],
       LTRIM(CASE WHEN d.is_auto_shrink_on = 1 THEN 'AUTO_SHRINK ' ELSE '' END
           + CASE WHEN d.is_auto_close_on = 1 THEN 'AUTO_CLOSE ' ELSE '' END
           + CASE WHEN d.page_verify_option <> 2 THEN 'PAGE_VERIFY ' ELSE '' END) AS [Risky Settings]
FROM sys.databases d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT database_name,
                  MAX(CASE WHEN type = 'D' THEN backup_finish_date END) AS full_dt,
                  MAX(CASE WHEN type = 'I' THEN backup_finish_date END) AS diff_dt,
                  MAX(CASE WHEN type = 'L' THEN backup_finish_date END) AS log_dt
           FROM msdb.dbo.backupset GROUP BY database_name) b ON b.database_name = d.name
LEFT JOIN (SELECT RTRIM(instance_name) AS n, cntr_value AS v FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters
           WHERE counter_name = 'Percent Log Used' AND object_name LIKE '%Databases%') lu ON lu.n = d.name
WHERE d.database_id > 4
ORDER BY d.name;
-- Grafana refresh dependencies: ${ag_listener:raw} | ${ag_cluster:raw} | ${replica_ds:raw} | ${replica_name:raw}

panels.title: 💿 File I/O Latency (since start)
panels.description: Average read/write latency per file. Targets: data reads < 20 ms, log writes < 5 ms

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 20 DB_NAME(vfs.database_id) + ' [' + mf.name + ']' AS [DB File], mf.type_desc AS [Type],
       CAST(vfs.io_stall_read_ms * 1.0 / NULLIF(vfs.num_of_reads, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS [Avg Read ms],
       CAST(vfs.io_stall_write_ms * 1.0 / NULLIF(vfs.num_of_writes, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS [Avg Write ms],
       vfs.num_of_reads AS [Reads], vfs.num_of_writes AS [Writes]
FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL, NULL) vfs
JOIN sys.master_files mf ON vfs.database_id = mf.database_id AND vfs.file_id = mf.file_id

FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats
WHERE wait_type IN ('THREADPOOL','RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE','WRITELOG','LOGBUFFER','PAGEIOLATCH_SH','PAGEIOLATCH_EX',
                    'IO_COMPLETION','LCK_M_X','LCK_M_U','LCK_M_S','CXPACKET','CXCONSUMER','SOS_SCHEDULER_YIELD',

panels.title: 🧱 Head Blockers
panels.description: Sessions that block others but are not blocked themselves

targets.rawSql:
WITH blockers AS (SELECT DISTINCT blocking_session_id AS sid FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE blocking_session_id > 0)
SELECT s.session_id AS [SID], s.login_name AS [Login], s.host_name AS [Host], LEFT(s.program_name, 40) AS [App],
       s.status AS [Status],
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r2 WHERE r2.blocking_session_id = s.session_id) AS [Blocked],
       DATEDIFF(SECOND, s.last_request_start_time, GETDATE()) AS [Since s],
       LEFT(ISNULL(t.text, ''), 100) AS [Last SQL]
FROM blockers b
JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = b.sid
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_exec_connections c ON c.session_id = s.session_id
OUTER APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(c.most_recent_sql_handle) t
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r WHERE r.session_id = b.sid AND r.blocking_session_id > 0)
ORDER BY [Blocked] DESC;
-- Grafana refresh dependencies: ${ag_listener:raw} | ${ag_cluster:raw} | ${replica_ds:raw} | ${replica_name:raw}

  n.e.value('(data/value/deadlock/process-list/process/@loginname)[1]', 'nvarchar(128)') AS [Login],
  n.e.value('(data/value/deadlock/process-list/process/@currentdbname)[1]', 'nvarchar(128)') AS [Database],

      JOIN sys.dm_xe_session_targets t ON s.address = t.event_session_address

CROSS APPLY a.x.nodes('RingBufferTarget/event[@name="xml_deadlock_report"]') n(e)
ORDER BY [Time] DESC;

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT vs.volume_mount_point, vs.logical_volume_name, vs.total_bytes, vs.available_bytes

panels.title: 🧬 Database Risk Register
panels.description: One row per DB: state, log reuse wait, log usage, backup ages, CHECKDB age and risky settings

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.name AS [Database], d.state_desc AS [State], d.recovery_model_desc AS [Recovery],
       d.log_reuse_wait_desc AS [Log Reuse Wait],
       CAST(lu.v AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS [Log Used %],
       DATEDIFF(HOUR, b.full_dt, GETDATE()) AS [Full Age h],
       DATEDIFF(HOUR, b.diff_dt, GETDATE()) AS [Diff Age h],
       DATEDIFF(MINUTE, b.log_dt, GETDATE()) AS [Log Age min],
       DATEDIFF(DAY, CAST(DATABASEPROPERTYEX(d.name, 'LastGoodCheckDbTime') AS DATETIME), GETDATE()) AS [CheckDB Age d],
       d.page_verify_option_desc AS [Page Verify],
       LTRIM(CASE WHEN d.is_auto_shrink_on = 1 THEN 'AUTO_SHRINK ' ELSE '' END
           + CASE WHEN d.is_auto_close_on = 1 THEN 'AUTO_CLOSE ' ELSE '' END
           + CASE WHEN d.page_verify_option <> 2 THEN 'PAGE_VERIFY ' ELSE '' END) AS [Risky Settings]
FROM sys.databases d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT database_name,
                  MAX(CASE WHEN type = 'D' THEN backup_finish_date END) AS full_dt,
                  MAX(CASE WHEN type = 'I' THEN backup_finish_date END) AS diff_dt,
                  MAX(CASE WHEN type = 'L' THEN backup_finish_date END) AS log_dt
           FROM msdb.dbo.backupset GROUP BY database_name) b ON b.database_name = d.name
LEFT JOIN (SELECT RTRIM(instance_name) AS n, cntr_value AS v FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters
           WHERE counter_name = 'Percent Log Used' AND object_name LIKE '%Databases%') lu ON lu.n = d.name
WHERE d.database_id > 4
ORDER BY d.name;
-- Grafana refresh dependencies: ${ag_listener:raw} | ${ag_cluster:raw} | ${replica_ds:raw} | ${replica_name:raw}

panels.description: Top 10 queries by average elapsed time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 10
    LEFT(SUBSTRING(qt.text, qs.statement_start_offset/2+1,

         ELSE qs.statement_end_offset END - qs.statement_start_offset)/2+1),80) AS [Query],
    CAST(qs.total_elapsed_time/qs.execution_count/1000.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [Avg ms]
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats qs
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) qt

JOIN sys.dm_tran_session_transactions st ON t.transaction_id=st.transaction_id
JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON st.session_id=s.session_id
WHERE t.transaction_type != 4
ORDER BY t.transaction_begin_time;

panels.description: Index usage per table

targets.rawSql:

    OBJECT_NAME(s.object_id) AS [Table],

    s.user_scans AS [Scans],
    s.user_lookups AS [Lookups],
    s.user_updates AS [Updates]

SELECT

    MAX(CASE WHEN counter_name='Target Server Memory (KB)' THEN cntr_value/1024 END) AS [Target Server MB],

panels.description: Job frequency (7d)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT j.name AS [Job], COUNT(*) AS [Runs]
FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j
JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory h ON j.job_id=h.job_id
WHERE h.run_date >= CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE()-7,112) AND h.step_id=0
GROUP BY j.name
ORDER BY [Runs] DESC;
-- Grafana refresh dependencies: ${ag_listener:raw} | ${ag_cluster:raw} | ${replica_ds:raw} | ${replica_name:raw}

panels.title: 📅 Job Frequency (7d)

panels.description: Running jobs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT j.name AS [Job],
    a.run_requested_date AS [Started],
    DATEDIFF(SECOND,a.run_requested_date,GETDATE()) AS [Duration (s)]
FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j
JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobactivity a ON j.job_id=a.job_id
WHERE a.run_requested_date IS NOT NULL AND a.stop_execution_date IS NULL
ORDER BY a.run_requested_date DESC;
-- Grafana refresh dependencies: ${ag_listener:raw} | ${ag_cluster:raw} | ${replica_ds:raw} | ${replica_name:raw}

panels.title: 🔄 Running Jobs

panels.description: Scheduled jobs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 20 j.name AS [Job],
    CASE WHEN a.run_requested_date IS NOT NULL AND a.stop_execution_date IS NULL THEN 'Running' ELSE 'Scheduled' END AS [Status],
    s.next_run_date AS [Next Run],
    s.next_run_time AS [Time]
FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j
LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobactivity a ON j.job_id=a.job_id
LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobschedules s ON j.job_id=s.job_id
WHERE (a.stop_execution_date IS NULL AND a.run_requested_date IS NOT NULL) OR s.next_run_date>0
ORDER BY s.next_run_date, s.next_run_time;
-- Grafana refresh dependencies: ${ag_listener:raw} | ${ag_cluster:raw} | ${replica_ds:raw} | ${replica_name:raw}
